about: Floors for tests/eval/retrieval/run.py, per embedder. test/hash-256 is the offline embedder CI uses (blocking): measured 12 Oct 2026 over three runs at hybrid recall@10 0.986, recall@5 0.959 to 0.968, MRR 0.903 to 0.913, nDCG@10 0.921 to 0.927, vector recall@10 0.697, citations 1.000; the floors leave room for the small run-to-run drift from ties in approximate vector search. The local model's floor is the documented one (tests/eval/README.md), checked nightly. Raise a floor when the numbers rise; never lower one without saying why in the commit.
